sources: https://reserve.floridastateparks.org/Web/#!park/61 (US eDirect API floridardr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 61, search/grid + search/details for every unit of facility 166 Loop 1, start date 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: $35 a night for an RV: the $28 campsite fee plus Florida's $7 nightly utility fee for RVs (tent campers pay $28), plus tax and a $6.70 reservation fee per reservation. No out-of-state rate; Florida residents 65 and over get half off the campsite fee.

fees.source: Reserve Florida search/details for every unit of facility 166 (all 53 units Rate 28.00, Fee 6.70), read 2026-10-21 + https://www.floridastateparks.org/fees ($7 nightly RV utility fee, as read 2026-10-12)

hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/sebastian-inlet-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('All 51 campsites have water and electrical hook-ups') + Reserve Florida search/details, facility 166 (Electric Hookup 30 on 45 units, 50 on 8; no sewer attribute), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The park says 51 campsites and 'Maximum RV length is 40 feet'; Reserve Florida lists 53 units, lengths 30-40 ft except two 50-ft pull-throughs (#033, #034). Sites 9-14 are waterfront with a view of the inlet. Site #056 is tent or pop-up only.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/sebastian-inlet-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('All 51 campsites', 'Maximum RV length is 40 feet') + Reserve Florida search/grid + search/details, facility 166 (VehicleLength, PullInTypeName, unit descriptions), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two bathhouses with toilets and showers in the campground; a Wi-Fi hotspot near the marina rather than in the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/sebastian-inlet-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('two bathhouses with ADA access to toilets and showers in the campground'; 'a dump station, and a Wi-Fi hotspot near the marina'; 'Laundry facilities are available at the campground for use by registered campers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on the Florida State Parks reservations website (Reserve Florida) or at 800-326-3521.

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/sebastian-inlet-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521'), read 2026-10-21
